translation.name: Ilagano lya Katali, Ilagano Linyale kwa Wanhu Weng’ha

content: (Kwa yalingwaluchiza kwimba. Ilanguso lya Daudi mhela Doegi, Mwedomu loyamlutile Sauli na kumlonjela, “Daudi nakaluta kaye kwa Ahimeleki.”)

content.text: Lekachoni kwangivuna kwa wihe wa hegwe, gwa mkulu?
Igano lya kwimilila lya Nguluwi lyangikala mazuwa gose.
Gwa mhadi, chila mhela kwanguwika goya kudumya,
umyango wa hegwe ndo kota nzembe.
Hegwe kwangugana wihe kusinda kunoga,
kwangugana udesi kusinda kulonga kukomya.
Gwa mhadi mkulu,
kwangugana mbuli za kuwadumya wanji.
Ahyo Nguluwi kokudumya mazuwa gose,
kokunyasula na kukusa kaye kwa hegwe,
kokung'umbula kuli isi ya wawele wakomu.
Watanganiche wogona ago na kudumba,
hamba wokuseka na kulonga,
“Mlole gamfichile munhu ayu.
Heye nahaganile Nguluwi yawe honhu ha heye ha kubilimila,
ila nayali yochitumbila winji wa lufufu lwa heye,
yochitumbila vinhu vyoyaholile kulawa kwa wanji.”
Ila heni ndo kota igodi idodi lya mzeituni,
lilingudedemka kuli ng'handa ya Nguluwi.
Ndangitumbila igano lya heye lya kwimilila mazuwa gose.
Gwa Nguluwi ndokulonjela malumbo mazuwa gose,
kwa chiwalo cha mbuli zouditile.
Ndowikula kota hegwe ndo unojile,
hali wanhu wa kukundigwa.
